text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Oka Sho. Ikuno Dictus felt 
the distinct, weighty atmosphere unique to 
Classic-class GⅠ races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. 
Precisely because it's a special race, the 
pressure is immense. Feeling that weight, 
she vowed to engrave this chance and this 
race into her very being.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Ikuno Dictus prayed that 
every Umamusume would be able to give it 
their all safely today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race for the first Tiara, the Oka Sho, 
begins—!
